title: Add betterado_release_folder resource with full CRUD and acceptance test
essence: Introduces the betterado_release_folder Terraform resource for managing Azure DevOps release-definition folders. Operators can now create, read, update, and destroy folder paths (e.g. \Production\Web) via Terraform. Includes 5 gomock unit tests, an acceptance test skeleton, and reference docs.

checkpoints.label: unit-tests
checkpoints.caption: 5 gomock unit tests for betterado_release_folder all pass
checkpoints.beforeNote: No betterado_release_folder resource existed; no tests existed.
checkpoints.afterNote: All 5 canonical unit tests pass: ExpandFlatten_Roundtrip, Create_Success, Create_Error, Read_NotFound, Delete_Error.

acceptanceCriteria: betterado_release_folder resource registered in provider.go, schema-valid, full CRUD implemented
5 canonical gomock unit tests pass: ExpandFlatten_Roundtrip, Create_Success, Create_Error, Read_NotFound, Delete_Error
Delete returns helpful error 'Cannot delete folder ... contains release definitions' when folder is non-empty
Acceptance test TestAccReleaseFolder_basic present (runs live with TF_ACC=1)
impact: Operators can now manage Azure DevOps release-definition folder hierarchies as Terraform resources
Enables IaC-driven folder organisation for release pipelines without manual portal clicks
Safe delete: provider refuses to cascade-delete folders containing definitions, preventing accidental data loss
